consensus_summary: Fans have mixed feelings about the 1969-09-07 show, with some appreciating the loose, improvisational nature of the performance while others criticize the sloppiness and drunkenness of the playing. The collaboration with Jorma Kaukonen and the unique setlist are highlights for many, despite the overall chaotic vibe.
